about: The offertorium of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The kings of Tharsis and the islands will offer gifts; the kings of the Arabians and of Saba will bring presents; all the kings of the earth will adore Him, and all nations will serve Him.

a.g: all the kings of the earth will adore Him
